game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Misty Bog, a misty bog: the forest ranger must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Misty Bog: a misty bog
core_gameplay_loop: In Misty Bog, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the seed vault using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The seed vault reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the seed vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
